summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the refiling of its Bilboes Gold Project Feasibility Study Technical Report to comply with Canadian NI 43-101 requirements after OSC review identified certain authors not meeting qualified person criteria. The updated Canadian Report was filed on SEDAR+ with replacement authors; the US Feasibility Study on EDGAR remains unchanged as DRA acts as sole qualified person under US rules. No effect on the project. This is a regulatory compliance filing with no corporate transaction, making it not a special situation.
